overview.about: The Aramco Championship is a big-money women's event backed by the Saudi oil giant, part of the wave of investment reshaping women's professional golf. It draws a strong international field to a top-class venue with one of the largest purses outside the majors.
overview.nextEvent: The next Aramco Championship offers one of the richest prizes in women's golf, with a limited elite field. Its Saudi backing places it at the centre of the game's shifting economics.
